intro: Latvians have collected more than a million folk songs, and their huge Song and Dance Festival is one of the largest choral events in the world.

chapters.title: People and language
text: About a third of Latvians live in Riga, the largest city in the Baltic states. Latvian and Lithuanian are the only surviving Baltic languages. About a quarter of the population is Russian-speaking.
Krišjānis Barons collected more than a million dainas, short folk songs, which are kept in a famous cabinet in Riga.

chapters.title: Midsummer
text: Jāņi, the midsummer festival, is the biggest holiday: people wear wreaths of flowers and oak leaves, sing, eat caraway cheese and stay up all night by bonfires.
